// Converts testdata/tiny/model.safetensors (written by gen_fixture.py) into
// testdata/tiny/model_int8b32.wtypw: every 2-D tensor in Int8Block32 (the layout of the real
// Qwen3.5-0.8B artifact), every other tensor in Float32, the same rule as weightsc -quant int8-block32.
//
// Run from a scratch module that requires webtyp.com/weights and webtyp.com/weightsc:
//   go run . testdata/tiny/model.safetensors testdata/tiny/model_int8b32.wtypw
package main

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"sort"

	"webtyp.com/weights"
	"webtyp.com/weightsc"
)

func main() {
	in, out := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	st, err := weightsc.OpenSafetensors(in)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer st.Close()
	var names []string
	for n := range st.Tensors {
		names = append(names, n)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	var inputs []weights.TensorInput
	quantized := 0
	for _, n := range names {
		f, shape, err := st.ReadTensorFloat32(n)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if len(shape) == 2 {
			rows, cols := shape[0], shape[1]
			data := make([]byte, 0, rows*cols)
			var scales []float32
			for r := 0; r < rows; r++ {
				q, s := weightsc.QuantizeBlocksInt8(f[r*cols : (r+1)*cols])
				for _, v := range q {
					data = append(data, byte(v))
				}
				scales = append(scales, s...)
			}
			inputs = append(inputs, weights.TensorInput{Name: n, DType: weights.Int8Block32, Shape: shape, Data: data, Scales: scales})
			quantized++
			continue
		}
		data := make([]byte, len(f)*4)
		for i, v := range f {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[i*4:], math.Float32bits(v))
		}
		inputs = append(inputs, weights.TensorInput{Name: n, DType: weights.Float32, Shape: shape, Data: data})
	}
	b, err := weights.WriteArtifact("qwen3.5-tiny-fixture-int8b32", 1, weights.TokenizerConfig{}, inputs)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, b, 0644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("tensors", len(inputs), "int8b32", quantized, "bytes", len(b))
}
